# Interpreter performance samples, 2026-09-04

Companion data for [the experiment report](interpreter-performance-2026-09-04.md). Values are retained in run order. Go runs alternate main/branch, branch/main, main/branch, branch/main, main/branch. JVM comparison runs alternate main/branch, branch/main, main/branch. No timing outliers were discarded.
